metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents, plus 9 optional MCP extensions (Matomo, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Banana, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Profound, Bing Webmaster, Unlighthouse). BeauBliss overlay: the seo-cockpit companion (function hooks on tool calls) is excluded; v2.4.2 also adds Google sign-in through your own gcloud account; v2.4.1 brought Google guidance current through 2026-09-28; v2.4.0 added /seo agentic for agent readiness.
